snippet.title: Civ Tour: Joseon | Civilization VII
snippet.description:
Build strength from within as 𝐉𝐎𝐒𝐄𝐎𝐍. Add the Joseon civilization to your collection in Sid Meier's Civilization VII!

This content is available as part of the Brush and Blade Collection DLC, featuring 2 leaders, 4 civilizations, and 4 Wonders.

► Get Civ 7 today: https://2kgam.es/Civ7
► Get the Brush & Blade Collection: https://2kgam.es/4vbwiKN

---------------------------------
HISTORY
---------------------------------
As stable as it was isolated, the Joseon Dynasty was a five-centuries-long period of peace in Korea, marked by the elaboration of Confucianism, a strong defense, and a carefully balanced political system. Founded in 1392, the kingdom lasted until just before the dawn of the 20th century, repelling invasion after invasion from its neighbors. It was a highly structured society, with a rich scholarly tradition that carefully monitored outside influences, selecting only that which would make Joseon prosper. It would fall in 1897, after pressure from the ascendant Meiji Empire and the United States became overwhelming.

---------------------------------
ABILITY
---------------------------------
Munchi:
- Antiquity Age: Increased Specialist Limit in the Capital. Decreased Specialist Limit in all Cities other than the Capital. Joseon begins the Age with a set City Limit. Can purchase Tier 1 Science and Culture Buildings in Towns.
- Exploration Age: Increased Specialist Limit in the Capital. Decreased Specialist Limit in all Cities other than the Capital. Joseon begins the Age with a set, increased City Limit. Can purchase Tier 1 Science and Culture Buildings in Towns.
- Modern Age (Apex): Further increased Specialist Limit in the Capital. Increased Specialist Limit all Cities other than the Capital with a Seowon Unique Quarter; decreased Specialist Limit in non-Capital Cities without a Seowon Unique Quarter. Joseon begins the Age with a set, increased City Limit. Can purchase Tier 1 Science and Culture Buildings in Towns.

---------------------------------
ATTRIBUTES
---------------------------------
- Cultural
- Expansionist

---------------------------------
TRADITIONS
---------------------------------
Gwageo
- Tier 1, Exploration Age: Increased Culture from Specialists; decreased Happiness on Specialists.
- Tier 2, Modern Age (Apex): Increased Culture from Specialists.

Hermit Kingdom
- Tier 1, Antiquity Age (Affirmation): Increased Happiness per Population in the Capital.
- Tier 2, Exploration Age (Affirmation): Further increased Happiness.

Silhak 
- Tier 1, Modern Age (Apex): Increased Science from Specialists.

Yangban Bureaucracy
- Tier 1, Exploration Age: Cities receive increased Food and Production on Districts with a set minimum number of Specialists.
- Tier 2, Modern Age (Apex): Cities receive further increased Food and Production in Districts with an increased amount of Specialists.

Yangbeobmiui
- Tier 1, Antiquity Age: Increased Culture per Population in the Capital. Increased Food in Towns with any Focus.
- Tier 2, Modern Age (Apex): Increased Culture per Population in the Capital and Cities with a Seowon Unique Quarter; decreased Culture in other Cities.


---------------------------------
INFRASTRUCTURE
---------------------------------
Seowon: Unique Quarter. This Settlement receives a percentage of its Production as Culture. If constructed in a Town, the Capital receives increased Population.
- Confucian Academy: Increased Culture. Increased Happiness Adjacency with Mountains and Wonders. Can be purchased in Towns, but cannot be built in the Capital.
- Printing House: Increased Science. Increased Production Adjacency with Quarters and Wonders. Can be purchased in Towns, but cannot be built in the Capital.

---------------------------------
CIVILIAN UNIT
---------------------------------
Jangyongyoung: Unique Army Commander Unit. Land Units in a Capital receive increased Combat Strength within the Command Radius.

---------------------------------
MILITARY UNIT
---------------------------------
Turtle Ship: Unique Heavy Naval Unit. Decreased Ranged and Bombard Strength compared to other Heavy Naval Units. Has increased Bombard Strength and increased Ranged Strength when on Coast Terrain.

---------------------------------
WONDER
---------------------------------
Hwaseong: Increased Culture, Tradition Slots, and Social Policy Slots. Acts as a Fortified District that must be conquered. Must be placed on a Flat tile adjacent to a minimum number of Rough tiles. Joseon receives increased Production toward constructing this Wonder.

---------------------------------
STARTING BIASES
---------------------------------
- Rough

---------------------------------
GAMEPLAY TIP
---------------------------------
Joseon has a unique statistic called City Limit. This is a limit on the number of Settlements that can be turned into Cities, so plan carefully!
